### ① Derived judgments

The published surface of `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` is its `exports` map (`.` only) plus `src/index.tsx`; neither changes, and `index.tsx` exports none of `isRetiredEnvelopeNode`, `LEGACY_RETIRED_WIDGET_SCHEMA`, `entryComponent`, `toDashboardNodeType` or `unsupportedWidgetSchema`. `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/react` are untouched (diff stat 0). So every contract change here is a change in what the two published renderers DRAW for a stored input. Each one, judged:

1. **The predicate, `isRetiredEnvelopeNode` (`legacyRetiredWidget.ts`) — right.** FROM a two-member retired set (`object-metric`, `plugin-dashboard:object-metric`) TO: a truthy envelope node is retired unless its `type` is a member of `DASHBOARD_COMPONENT_WIDGET_TYPES`, which is `['metric-card']` on this head (`packages/types/src/complex.ts:2182`). That is the authoring accept set by construction: the zod slot arm is `z.enum(DASHBOARD_COMPONENT_WIDGET_TYPES)` with every other node sent to `WidgetComponentSlotRefusal` (`zod/complex.zod.ts:1342`, `:1412`), and the TypeScript twin is `component?: DashboardWidgetSlotComponentSchema` (`complex.ts:2310`). One constant, read by both faces and the draw, so they cannot drift. A falsy envelope still answers false, as before (a falsy `component` was never an envelope on either surface).
2. **`DashboardRenderer` envelope draw — right, a narrowing.** A non-`metric-card` node now returns the EXISTING `LEGACY_RETIRED_WIDGET_SCHEMA` object (content "This widget uses a retired data format. Edit it to bind a dataset.", which the changeset quotes verbatim) and sends no query. This is the retirement the card owes, to the existing placeholder. ⛔ No new placeholder: holds.
3. **`DashboardGridLayout` envelope draw — right, the same narrowing**, through the same imported predicate.
4. **The `toRenderableSchema` bridge removed from both surfaces — right.** It bridged the removed `SchemaNode` arm of the slot type (gone since PR objectui#12229): a string, number or `true` in the envelope used to draw as text; now each is a truthy non-object, `type` undefined, retired, so it draws the placeholder under the card heading. Both faces refuse a primitive at `component`; pinned for all three primitives on both surfaces. After the `if (authoredComponent)` narrowing the node is a `DashboardWidgetSlotComponentSchema`, which `SchemaRenderer` takes with no bridge (`Type Check` success). `toRenderableSchema` stays exported from `@object-ui/react` with many other callers; nothing is orphaned.
5. **The namespaced node key `plugin-dashboard:metric-card` stored in the envelope — right, and the one edge worth naming.** It drew before (the registry has that key) and is retired now, because the slot's accept set is the widget-vocabulary spelling `metric-card` that both faces take; the namespaced key is the renderer's internal registration that `toDashboardNodeType` produces, not an authorable spelling. Pinned, and the pin also asserts the zod face refuses it. The draw equals authoring here too.
6. **A bare `metric` node in the envelope — right, covered by the rule, not pinned by name.** `toDashboardNodeType` used to move it onto `plugin-dashboard:metric` and draw the inline metric; `metric` is not a member of the one-element list, so it now draws the placeholder, which is what the zod enum refuses it as. Consistent; the changeset's "any node other than a `metric-card`" covers it.
7. **The filter-bar broadcast no longer reaches an envelope `object-chart` or `object-data-table` — right, a consequence of 2.** Neither node reaches `isFilterableComponentSchema` any more. Declared in the changeset; the 11525 block that pinned the broadcast on the envelope is replaced with a dated note, and the new file pins the retirement WITH the filter bar set so the broadcast's absence is read, not assumed.
8. **`DashboardRenderer`'s bespoke `custom`-with-no-`component` prompt removed — right; a drawn-output change outside the `entryComponent` branch, judged in ③ as the dev's own flag.** The prompt told an author to "set `component` to a UIComponent schema", which after items 1–5 is exactly what authoring refuses and the draw retires, so the prompt became false in this change. It now falls through to `unsupportedWidgetSchema('custom')` (content "「custom」chart type is not supported yet", quoted verbatim in the changeset), which `DashboardGridLayout` already drew for that input on `main` (the grid has no `custom` arm; it ends in `unsupportedWidgetSchema(widgetType)`). One placeholder removed, none added; the two surfaces now agree. Ruling C's "D not taken" is respected: `custom` stays in `WidgetDispatchFamily` and `DASHBOARD_WIDGET_TYPE_EXTENSIONS`, and a `custom` widget holding a `metric-card` still draws the card (CONTROL pinned on both surfaces).
9. **Empty or falsy envelope — unchanged, right.** The widget draws by its family, as before.
10. **A `metric-card` lacking `value` in the envelope — unchanged, out of this card.** The predicate judges `type` only, so such a node draws as it did before while the zod face refuses it (objectui#11483). This PR neither widens nor narrows that; it is the pre-existing type-level accept set the card asked the slot to draw.
11. **Docs (`content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx`, `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`) — right.** The paragraph that said the surfaces "still draw a stored envelope as they always did" now states the rule the code implements; "the labelled placeholder described next" resolves to the following paragraph's "「type」chart type is not supported yet". `WidgetDispatchFamily`'s `custom` docblock is comment-only.
12. **Pins — right.** `envelopeDrawRetired-12254.test.tsx`: 30 cases on two surfaces (9 retired inputs, 3 heading cases, the `custom`-no-component case, 2 CONTROLs, each ×2). Each retired case asserts, in one test, that the surface hands `SchemaRenderer` the placeholder BY IDENTITY, that nothing of the node reaches screen or renderer, that `find`/`aggregate`/`queryDataset` are not called, AND that the zod face refuses the same widget at `component` — so the draw's accept set and authoring's are pinned equal, not merely described equal. Fixture triage: 11514 §3 (primitive bridge) and the 11525 broadcast block pinned the removed branch and are retired with dated notes; 11170 is re-spelled to a `metric-card` and the slot declaration stays true. Reverse verification (two WRAP legs, direction stated in the file header before the run, restore equals HEAD) is read from the PR body; it is the dev's own run, not re-run here.
13. **The ruling's conditions in the diff — hold.** ⛔ No new placeholder (one removed). The census is read-only and names each unread store: cloud is a row of its own, "UNREAD, not 0", with both refusals quoted (the clone's "terminal prompts disabled" and the REST 403), and every read store carries a control count of `widgets` arrays reached, so a 0 is a reading. A count above 0 would have shipped no code: every readable store read 0 outside tests and docs. The spec claim the PR makes is true on the objectstack checkout: `QUARANTINED_WIDGET_KEYS` is `['component', 'data']` in `WIDGET_GUIDANCE_SETS` (`dashboard.zod.ts:188`), fed as `guidanceSets` to the `strictObject` that is `DashboardWidgetSchema` (`:1081`), so a spec-valid stored widget cannot carry `component` at all.
